title: GOOD MORNING JESUS CHRIST | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: Good morning, Jesus. I worship you this morning as the King of Kings and the Lord of Lords. I honor you as the Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last. Jesus, you are the bright and morning star, and I celebrate your rising in my life at the dawn of this new day. I acknowledge you as my Lord, my Savior, my redeemer, my deliverer, my healer, my provider and my everything. Thank you for the gift of life. Thank you for breath in my lungs. Thank you for strength in my body.

Thank you for clarity in my mind. Thank you for peace in my heart. Thank you for this new day that you have made. And I choose to rejoice and be glad in it. Jesus, I declare that you are Lord over this day. You are Lord over every hour, every minute, every second. You are Lord over every conversation I will have. You are Lord over every decision I will make. You are Lord over every place I will go. You are Lord over every person I will meet. I submit this entire day to your lordship.

I surrender my plans to your purposes. I yield my agenda to your will. I decree and declare that your kingdom comes and your will is done in my life today as it is in heaven. Let heaven invade earth to me. Let your glory be manifested through my life. Let your power be demonstrated through my actions. Let your love be revealed through my words. I thank you, Jesus, for dying on the cross for my sins. I thank you for shedding your precious blood to redeem me from the curse of the law.

I thank you for bearing my sicknesses and carrying my diseases. I thank you for being wounded for my transgressions and bruised for my iniquities. I thank you that the chastisement of my peace was upon you and by your stripes I am healed. I thank you for descending into hell and taking the keys of Beth and Hades. I thank you for rising from the dead on the third day with all power in your hands. I thank you for ascending to the right hand of the father where you ever live to make intercession for me.

Jesus, I am alive today because you died for me. I am free today because you paid the price for my freedom. I am victorious today because you won the victory at Calvary. Lord Jesus, I decree and declare that I walk in resurrection power today. The same spirit that raised Christ from the dead dwells in me and quickens my mortal body. I am not walking in human strength today. I am walking in divine ability. I am not operating in natural wisdom today. I am operating in supernatural insight.

I am not functioning in fleshly capacity today. I am functioning in kingdom authority. Jesus, you said that all authority in heaven and on earth has been given to you and you have delegated that authority to me as your disciple. Therefore, I go into this day clothed with your authority. I speak with your authority. I act with your authority. I decree with your authority. Demons tremble at the mention of your name on my lips. Circumstances bow to your authority walking through me.

Impossibilities give way to possibilities because of your power operating in me. Jesus, I ask you to open my eyes today to see what you are doing. Give me spiritual vision to perceive kingdom realities. Let me see people the way you see them. Let me see situations the way you see them. Let me see opportunities the way you see them. Remove every veil from my spiritual eyes. Take away every scale that limits my perception. Cleanse my vision from the contamination of this world. I want to see your glory today.

I want to witness your power today. I want to behold your majesty today. I want to observe your workings today. Let my eyes be enlightened that I may know the hope of your calling, the riches of the GLORY OF YOUR INHERITANCE IN THE SAINTS, and the exceeding greatness of your power toward us who believe. I decree and declare that I hear your voice today. Jesus, you said that your sheep hear your voice and follow you. I am your sheep and I tune my spiritual ears to hear what you are saying.

Speak to me through your word. Speak to me through your spirit. Speak to me through circumstances. Speak to me through people. Speak to me through dreams and visions. Speak to me however you choose. But let me have ears to hear. I silence every other voice that competes for my attention. I turn down the volume of the world's noise. I shut out the voice of the enemy. I ignore the voice of fear. I disregard the voice of doubt. I refuse the voice of unbelief.

The only voice I want to hear clearly today is yours, Jesus. Your voice brings life. Your voice brings peace. Your voice brings direction. Your voice brings clarity. Your voice brings power. Jesus. Jesus. I ask you to order my steps today. Direct my path. Lead me in the way I should go. Make my way straight before you. When I should turn to the right, guide me right. When I should turn to the left, guide me left. When I should go forward, propel me forward. When I should wait, give me grace to wait.

Let me not run ahead of you. Let me not l behind you. Let me not deviate from your path. I want to walk where you walked. I want to go where you sent me. I want to do what you command me. I want to say what you tell me. I decree that my steps are ordered by the Lord today. and I walk in divine alignment with your purpose for my life. I declare that I am a disciple of Jesus Christ today. I am a follower of the lamb wherever he goes. I am a student sitting at the feet of the master teacher. Jesus, teach me today.

Instruct me in your ways. Train me in your principles. Educate me in your wisdom. Show me how to live. Show me how to love. Show me how to serve. Show me how to sacrifice. Show me how to forgive. Show me how to pray. Show me how to worship. Show me how to witness. Show me how to overcome. I want to be like you, Jesus. I want to think like you think. I want to speak like you speak. I want to act like you act. I want to love like you love.

transform me into your image from glory to glory by the spirit of the living God. I decree and declare that I abide in you today. Jesus, you said that if I abide in you and your words abide in me, I can ask whatever I will and it shall be done for me. I choose to remain in you. I choose to stay connected to you. I choose to maintain intimacy with you. You are the vine. I am the branch. Apart from you, I can do nothing. But connected to you, I can bear much fruit. I want to be a fruitful branch today.

I want to produce the fruit of righteousness. I want to yield the fruit of the spirit. I want to manifest the fruit of good works. Prune me where I need pruning. Cut away everything in my life that does not glorify you. Remove every dead branch. Eliminate every unfruitful habit. Destroy every hindering mindset. Make me a productive branch that brings glory to the father. Lord Jesus Jesus, I thank you that you are my good shepherd. You lead me beside still waters. You make me lie down in green pastures.

You restore my soul. You lead me in paths of righteousness for your name's sake. Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me. You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over. Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever. I decree that as my shepherd you guide me today.

You protect me today. You provide for me today. You preserve me today. I shall not want because you are my shepherd. I declare that I am more than a conqueror through Christ who loves me. I am not a victim today. I am a victor. I am not defeated. I am triumphant. I am not weak. I am strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. I am not afraid. I am bold as a lion. I am not confused. I have a sound mind. I am not sick. I am healed by your stripes. I am not poor.

I am blessed with every spiritual blessing in heavenly places. I am not alone. You are with me always even to the end of the age. Jesus, because you live, I can face tomorrow. Because you conquered, I am a conqueror. Because you overcame, I am an overcomer. Your victory is my victory. Your triumph is my triumph. Your resurrection is my resurrection. I decree and declare that I put on the Lord Jesus Christ today. I am clothed with Christ. I am wrapped in your righteousness. I am covered with your blood.

I am protected by your name. I wear you like a garment, Jesus. When people see me, let them see you. When people hear me, let them hear you. When people encounter me, let them encounter you. I am a representative of Christ today. I am an ambassador of the kingdom. I am a carrier of your presence. I am a vessel of your glory. Use me today to touch lives. Use me today to heal the broken. Use me today to set the captives free. Use me today to preach good news to the poor. Use me today to demonstrate your powerus.

Jesus, I thank you for your names. You are Emmanuel, God with us. You are the prince of peace. You are the wonderful counselor. You are the mighty God. You are the everlasting father. You are the rose of Sharon. You are the lily of the valley. You are the bread of life. You are the living water. You are the light of the world. You are the door. You are the way, the truth, and the life. You are the resurrection and the life. You are the good shepherd. You are the true vine.

You are the lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. I worship you by all your names this morning. I honor you in all your attributes. I magnify you in all your glory. I declare that I fix my eyes on Jesus today, the author and finisher of my faith. I look unto you, Jesus. I gaze upon you. I behold you. I contemplate you. I meditate on you. You are my focus. You are my priority. You are my preoccupation. I will not look at the storms around me. I will not look at the challenges before me.

I will not look at the giants opposing me. I will not look at the mountains blocking me. I keep my eyes on you, Jesus. When I look at you, I walk on water. When I look at circumstances, I sing. So today, I choose to fix my gaze on you. You are the same yesterday, today, and forever. You never change. Your promises never fail. Your word never returns void. Your love never ends. Your mercy never ceases. Your grace is always sufficient. I decree and declare that greater is he who is in me than he who is in the world.

Jesus, you dwell in me. You live in me. You abide in me. My body is your temple. My heart is your throne room. My life is your dwelling place. Because you are in me. I am greater than any challenge I face today. I am bigger than any problem I encounter today. I AM STRONGER THAN any opposition I meet today. I am wiser than any dilemma I confront today. Greater is in me and greater makes me greater. I do not operate from my own limited resources. I operate from the unlimited resources of Christ who dwells in me.

I draw from your strength. I tap into your wisdom. I access your power. I utilize your grace Jesus. Father Jesus, I ask you to give me your heart for people today. Let me see with your eyes of compassion. Let me feel with your heart of mercy. Let me reach out with your hands of healing. Let me speak with your words of grace. You had compassion on the multitudes because they were like sheep without a shepherd. Give me that same compassion today. You wept over Jerusalem. Give me that same burden for the lost.

You touch the lepers. Give me that same courage to reach the untouchables. You at with sinners. Give me that same willingness to associate with the broken. You forgave the woman caught in adultery. Give me that same spirit of forgiveness. You died for your enemies. Give me that same capacity to love those who oppose me. I declare that I am crucified with Christ. Nevertheless, I live yet not I, but Christ lives in me.

The life I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God who loved me and gave himself for me. I am dead to sin and alive to God. I am dead to the world and alive to Christ. I am dead to self and alive to the spirit. My old man was crucified with Christ. My old nature was buried with him. My old life was terminated at the cross. I have been raised with Christ to walk in newness of life. I am a new creation. Old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new. I do not live for myself anymore.

I live for him who died for me and rose again. Jesus, take over my life completely today. Let your life be expressed through my life. LET YOUR CHARACTER be manifested through my character. LET YOUR POWER BE demonstrated through my actions. I decree and declare that I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me. There is nothing impossible for me today because nothing is impossible with God and God is in me. I am not limited by my education. I am not restricted by my experience.

I am not confined by my background. I am not bound by my circumstances. I AM EMPOWERED BY the one who created the universe with his words. I am strengthened by the one who holds all things together by the power of his word. I am enabled by the one who raised the dead, heal the sick, cast out demons, and calm the storms. If God be for me, who can be against me? If Christ is in me, what can stop me? If the spirit empowers me, what can hinder me? I am unstoppable because Christ makes me unstoppable.

I am invincible because Christ makes me invincible. I am victorious because Christ makes me victorious. Father Jesus, I thank you for your grace that is sufficient for me. Your grace is enough for today. Your grace covers my weaknesses. Your grace compensates for my inadequacies. Your grace completes my insufficiencies. Your grace perfects your strength in my weakness. I boast in my weaknesses that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

I am content with weaknesses, with insults, with hardships, with persecutions, with difficulties. FOR WHEN I am weak, then I am strong. Your grace teaches me to say no to ungodliness. Your grace trains me to live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present world. Your grace empowers me to reign in life. I do not frustrate the grace of God. I do not receive the grace of God in vain. I stand in this grace. I glory in this grace. I am what I am by the grace of God.

I declare that the joy of the Lord is my strength today. Jesus, you are my joy. You are my exceeding joy. In your presence is fullness of joy. At your right hand are pleasures forever more. I rejoice in you today. I rejoice in your salvation. I rejoice in your victory. I rejoice in your promises. I rejoice in your faithfulness. I rejoice in your goodness. I rejoice in your mercy. I rejoice in your love. This joy is not based on my circumstances. This joy is not dependent on my feelings.

This joy is not determined by my situations. This joy is rooted in you, Jesus. And you never change. Therefore, my joy remains constant. My joy stays full. My joy flows continuously. This joy is my strength. This joy is my power. This joy is my energy. I go into this day with joy unspeakable and full of glory. I decree and declare that I take up my cross daily and follow Jesus. I deny myself. I die to my selfish ambitions. I crucify my fleshly desires. I surrender my will to your will.

I submit my plans to your purposes. I yield my agenda to your assignments, Jesus. Where you lead me, I will follow. What you command me, I will do. What you say to me, I will obey. I am not my own. I was bought with a price. I belong to you. My life is yours. My time is yours. My talents are yours. My treasures are yours. My everything is yours. Use me as you please. Send me where you want. Deploy me how you desire. I am available. I am willing. I am ready. Here I am. Lord, send me Jesus.

Mantara aba father Jesus I thank you for your peace that you give to me. You said peace I live with you. My peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled. Neither let it be afraid. I receive your peace today. Your peace guards my heart. Your peace guards my mind. Your peace keeps me in perfect rest. I refuse anxiety. I reject worry. I resist fear. I rebuke panic. I cast down every thought that tries to steal my peace. I will not be troubled. I will not be afraid.

I will not be anxious about anything. In everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, I let my requests be made known to God. And the peace of God which surpasses all understanding guards my heart and mind through Christ Jesus. Let your peace rule in my heart as an umpire. Let your peace dominate my emotions. Let your peace control my reactions. Let your peace govern my responses. I declare that I am the light of the world because Jesus, the light of the world, lives in me.

I am a city set on a hill that cannot be hidden. I am a lamp shining in a dark place. Jesus, you said to let my light shine before men that they may see my good works and glorify the father in heaven. I let my light shine today. I do not hide it under a basket. I do not deem it for anyone. I shine brightly in this dark world. My life is a testimony of your goodness. My work is a witness of your power. My words are a declaration of your truth. My actions are a demonstration of your love.

People see me and are drawn to you. People encounter me and want to know you. People hear me and desire to follow you. I am salt and light in this generation. I am a preserving agent in a decaying society. I am an illuminating force in a darkened world. I decree and declare that I am seated with Christ in heavenly places far above all principality and power and might and dominion and every name that is name. Jesus, you have raised me up together with you and made me sit together in the heavenly places.

I am not headbound today. I am heavenminded. I set my affections on things above, not on things on the earth. I see from heaven's perspective. I think from heaven's viewpoint. I speak from heaven's position. I act from heaven's authority. I am above, not beneath. I am the head, not the tail. I am above circumstances, not under circumstances. I am over situations, not overwhelmed by situations. I reign in life through Christ Jesus. I have dominion through him. I have authority through him.

I rule and govern through him. Jesus, I thank you that this is the day you have made. I will rejoice and be glad in it. This is not just another day. This is A DAY OF DIVINE VISITATION. This is a day of supernatural manifestation. This is a day of kingdom demonstration. This is a day of glory revelation. Something significant will happen today. Someone will be blessed today. Some situation will change today. Some testimony will emerge today. I go forth expecting miracles. I go forth anticipating breakthroughs.

I go forth believing for the impossible. I go forth knowing that you go before me. I go forth confident that you are with me. I go forth assured that you have my back. This is my day. This is my time. This is my season. This is my moment. I shall not waste it. I shall not lose it. I shall not forfeit it. I maximize this day for your glory. Jesus, I seal this prayer in your precious name. Lord Jesus Christ, you are worthy of all praise. You are worthy of all honor. You are worthy of all glory.

You are worthy of all worship. You are the name above every name. You are the king above every king. You are the Lord above every Lord. I love you, Jesus. I adore you, Jesus. I worship you, Jesus. I magnify you, Jesus. I exalt you, Jesus. Thank you for loving me. Thank you for saving me. Thank you for keeping me. Thank you for blessing me. Thank you for walking with me today in your matchless, mighty, wonderful, powerful, glorious name. I pray. Amen. And amen.
